caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular chest with measurements of 43 1/2 inches in width, 22 inches in depth, and 32 1/2 inches in height, presented in both front and side views. The front panel is divided into five main sections, with the three central sections featuring intricate decorative patterns and one of them containing the initials "E.G." The entire front face, except for the section above the legs, is covered with elaborate, symmetrical, plant-like carvings composed of swirling lines, leaves, and dots. The legs and vertical supports on the front are also carved with similar designs. In contrast, the side panel, as noted in the image, contains no carving or decorative detail and is plain with visible horizontal and vertical framing. Annotations on the side view indicate that the spaces (not lines) between grooves represent rounded grooves measuring 1/8 inch deep and 1/8 inch wide. The paper is off-white, and all drawings and notations are made with black ink. Several handwritten notes, including scale (1/2 inch = 1 foot), a museum reference number, and the name "John Dietrich" with the date "April 14 - 36," are also present on the drawing.
title: Chest
